title: One More Shift Demo V2 - Feedback
author: Weird_Sky_104
selftext:
Hi all :)

It’s been a while since I posted the first demo here. Back then the game was still called Recycler. Since then it got a small rebranding, a lot of rebuilding... and honestly, it feels like a real game now. \^\^

I received some feedback after the first demo. It was not much, but I was really happy to receive any at all. Big thanks to you guys ;) More importantly, it made me feel like this game actually has something! So instead of rushing into the next level, I spent a lot of time building a stronger foundation. The core gameplay seems to work.

What is new?

* Full asset rebuild. A lot more details and mechanics. You can see and track every material in your factory!
* A complete rebuild of the tutorial. For complete beginners and factory veterans.
* Better belt placement
* Hotkeys
* A new T3 machine with 3 recipes
* Recipes for T1 machines
* And hopefully more clarity in general \^\^

Coding was handled with Claude, and Codex was my sparring partner for the assets.

While I am confident that I now have a strong foundation to start with the next level, I think there is still work left. But for that I really need some feedback :)

I was tuning the balance of the first factory because it seemed too easy for me, and at one point I was like: waaait a minute. I have a lot of milestones active, bought many licenses, and I know how to win this level... this is a level for a new player, not me \^\^

So I discarded those changes and thought: yup, time for a new level.

Try it out! And please use the feedback button ;)

  
[https://drabarus.itch.io/oms](https://drabarus.itch.io/oms)
